## Deck Goal
Teach frontend-oriented AEM developers to understand the local development system, route a change to the correct WKND module, and distinguish build validation from installation and runtime verification.

## Required Background

    "core_claim": "Before editing a file, name the change, identify the module that owns its lifecycle, then verify the assembled result.",
    "canonical_terms": [
      "WKND source project",
      "AEM SDK",
      "Dispatcher Tools",
      "Maven reactor",
      "core",
      "ui.apps",
      "ui.content",

  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "ui.content packages project-managed content, ui.config carries environment-aware OSGi configuration, dispatcher contains delivery configuration and all aggregates the deployable application. Module placement signals lifecycle and ownership."

}
